name: swim_h2o_drops
description: Interior water, held out (physics.md 6.6): the player dropped 5 units above the water surface of the Old World Blues interior NVDLC03SLH2OINT (CELL XCLW -232, has-water flag) over floors 456-496 (deep), 136 (deeper than the swimming depth of 100, shallower than the floating height plus a body) and 38 below the surface (shallow), each with at least 300 units clear above: does the interior's water stop the fall and float the player as the lake did. Points chosen 2026-10-08 from vertical rays of `fnvtool phys cell --cell NVDLC03SLH2OINT` (down and up from the surface on a 100-unit grid).
